prompt: Create a cinematic vertical surreal miniature construction scene: a colossal vanilla soft-serve ice cream cone towers from a snowy white landscape like an architectural megaproject, centered in frame. The cone is a realistic golden waffle cone with deep grid texture, and the enormous spiral of glossy white soft-serve rises above it in stacked ridges, snowy and creamy at the same time. Around it are exactly 17 tiny construction workers in orange hard hats and safety gear, each doing a distinct task: 1 worker in a boom lift spraying white ice-cream/snow onto the upper left swirl, 1 worker near the peak holding a tool, 1 worker standing at the very top with a vertical pole, 1 worker on the upper left ridge climbing/inspecting, 1 worker on the upper front ridge smoothing the surface, 1 worker on the right upper ridge working with a tool, 1 worker on the left side carrying or bracing a ladder, 1 worker on the center ridge chiseling, 1 worker suspended at the right side by cables, 1 worker on a hanging platform at the right gesturing while spraying crumbs, 1 worker standing on the snowy ridge near the cone, 1 worker at the base of the cone digging, 1 worker walking in front of the cone, 1 worker beside the foreground loader, 1 worker near the excavator arm, 1 worker at the lower right edge, and 1 worker near the dump truck. Include exactly 6 construction machines or equipment items: 1 yellow telescoping boom lift on the left, 1 yellow bulldozer/loader at bottom left, 1 yellow excavator at bottom center-right, 1 orange dump truck filled with white material at lower right, 1 small backhoe/loader on the right ridge, and 1 suspended work platform hanging from crane cables on the right. Add two tall ladders leaning against the cone and ice cream, cable lines on the right, piles of shaved ice/snow covering the ground, and drifting white spray where workers are carving or applying material. Background: rich blue sky with puffy cumulus clouds, bright daylight, crisp shadows, whimsical yet photorealistic scale contrast, high detail, tilt-shift miniature feel, no text, no logos. Present the image inside a centered tall rounded-rectangle frame on a clean white page, with generous white margin around the artwork, as if it is a vertical poster or social media card. Use 4:5 vertical composition, ultra-detailed cinematic lighting, realistic textures, vibrant colors, playful fantasy realism.

promptZh: 创作一个电影感垂直超现实微缩施工场景：一个巨大的 香草软冰淇淋蛋筒 如同建筑巨型工程般矗立在白雪皑皑的景观中，位于画面中心。蛋筒为写实的金色华夫饼蛋筒，具有深邃的网格纹理，巨大的光泽白色软冰淇淋螺旋在上方堆叠隆起，既有雪感又充满奶油质感。周围有 17 名戴着橙色安全帽和防护装备的微型建筑工人，每人都在执行不同的任务：1 名工人在高空作业车上向左上方旋涡喷洒白色冰淇淋/雪，1 名工人在顶部附近手持工具，1 名工人站在最顶端手持垂直杆，1 名工人在左上脊处攀爬/检查，1 名工人在左前脊处平整表面，1 名工人在右上脊处使用工具，1 名工人在左侧搬运或支撑梯子，1 名工人在中心脊处凿刻，1 名工人通过缆绳悬挂在右侧，1 名工人在右侧悬挂平台上边喷洒碎屑边做手势，1 名工人站在蛋筒附近的雪脊上，1 名工人在蛋筒底部挖掘，1 名工人在蛋筒前方行走，1 名工人在前景装载机旁，1 名工人在挖掘机臂附近，1 名工人在右下边缘，1 名工人在自卸卡车附近。包含 6 种施工机械或设备：左侧 1 台黄色伸缩臂高空作业车，左下方 1 台黄色推土机/装载机，中右下方 1 台黄色挖掘机，右下方 1 台装满白色物料的橙色自卸卡车，右脊上 1 台小型挖掘装载机，以及右侧由起重机缆绳悬挂的 1 个工作平台。添加两架靠在蛋筒和冰淇淋上的高梯、右侧的缆线、覆盖地面的碎冰/雪堆，以及工人们雕刻或涂抹材料时产生的漂浮白色喷雾。背景：深蓝色天空配以蓬松的积云，明亮的日光，清晰的阴影，奇幻而逼真的比例对比，高细节，移轴微缩感，无文字，无标志。将图像呈现于简洁白色页面中央的圆角长方形框内，艺术品周围留有宽裕的白色边距，如同垂直海报或社交媒体卡片。使用 4:5 垂直 构图，超精细电影级光效，写实纹理，鲜艳色彩，俏皮的奇幻现实主义。
